## Problem and result

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior or documentation improvement.
Link related issues and state the roadmap phase this change belongs to.

## Scope

List the affected areas and explain important decisions or compatibility implications.
Disclose material AI assistance and how its output was verified, if applicable.

## Validation

List checks actually performed and their results. Include remaining limitations or
unresolved questions. Do not claim commands or platforms were tested unless they were.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The scope follows the specification and current authorized phase.
- [ ] Claims and examples are grounded in repository evidence.
- [ ] Relevant documentation and Unreleased changelog entries are updated.
- [ ] Links, Markdown rendering, and applicable assets have been checked.
- [ ] Published prose contains no unresolved authoring placeholders.
- [ ] License notices and third-party attribution are preserved.
- [ ] No secrets or private information are included.

For sensitive concerns, follow SECURITY.md before opening a public pull request.
